Structure: {"schema":"dbo","name":"AcquirePageQuotaLock","type":"P ","definition":"CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.AcquirePageQuotaLock @ConsumerId smallint AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; IF @@TRANCOUNT=0 THROW 50016, \u0027Page quota lock requires a transaction.\u0027, 1; DECLARE @resource nvarchar(255)=CONCAT(\u0027DocAi.PageQuota.\u0027,@ConsumerId), @rc int; EXEC @rc=sys.sp_getapplock @Resource=@resource,@LockMode=\u0027Exclusive\u0027,@LockOwner=\u0027Transaction\u0027,@LockTimeout=10000; IF @rc\u003C0 THROW 50016, \u0027Page quota lock could not be acquired.\u0027, 1; END;","uses_ansi_nulls":true,"uses_quoted_identifier":true,"is_disabled":null,"is_instead_of_trigger":null,"is_not_for_replication":null}

{"schema":"dbo","name":"ConsumerPageBalance","type":"V ","definition":"CREATE VIEW dbo.ConsumerPageBalance AS SELECT c.ConsumerId, COALESCE(g.Pages,CONVERT(bigint,0))-COALESCE(ch.Pages,CONVERT(bigint,0))-COALESCE(r.Pages,CONVERT(bigint,0)) AS AvailablePages FROM dbo.Consumers c OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(Pages) Pages FROM dbo.PageAllowanceGrants WHERE ConsumerId=c.ConsumerId) g OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(Pages) Pages FROM dbo.CustomerPageCharges WHERE ConsumerId=c.ConsumerId) ch OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(Pages) Pages FROM dbo.PageReservations WHERE ConsumerId=c.ConsumerId AND State=\u0027Reserved\u0027) r;","uses_ansi_nulls":true,"uses_quoted_identifier":true,"is_disabled":null,"is_instead_of_trigger":null,"is_not_for_replication":null}

{"schema":"dbo","name":"ReconcilePageReservations","type":"P ","definition":"CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.ReconcilePageReservations AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; DECLARE @consumerId smallint,@jobId uniqueidentifier,@runNo smallint; DECLARE consumers CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR SELECT DISTINCT ConsumerId FROM dbo.PageReservations WHERE State=\u0027Reserved\u0027; OPEN consumers; FETCH NEXT FROM consumers INTO @consumerId; WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION; EXEC dbo.AcquirePageQuotaLock @consumerId; DECLARE runs CURSOR LOCAL STATIC READ_ONLY FOR SELECT r.JobId,r.RunNo FROM dbo.JobRuns r JOIN dbo.PageReservations p ON p.JobId=r.JobId AND p.RunNo=r.RunNo WHERE p.ConsumerId=@consumerId AND p.State=\u0027Reserved\u0027 AND (r.Status\u003C\u003E\u0027Active\u0027 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.UsageLedger l WHERE l.JobId=r.JobId AND l.RunNo=r.RunNo AND l.ReversesUsageId IS NULL)); OPEN runs; FETCH NEXT FROM runs INTO @jobId,@runNo; WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN EXEC dbo.SettlePageReservation @jobId,@runNo; FETCH NEXT FROM runs INTO @jobId,@runNo; END; CLOSE runs; DEALLOCATE runs; COMMIT; END TRY BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()\u003C\u003E0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH; FETCH NEXT FROM consumers INTO @consumerId; END; CLOSE consumers; DEALLOCATE consumers; END;","uses_ansi_nulls":true,"uses_quoted_identifier":true,"is_disabled":null,"is_instead_of_trigger":null,"is_not_for_replication":null}

{"schema":"dbo","name":"SettlePageReservation","type":"P ","definition":"CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.SettlePageReservation @JobId uniqueidentifier,@RunNo smallint AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; DECLARE @consumerId smallint, @status varchar(12), @pages bigint, @usageId bigint, @operationId bigint; SELECT @consumerId=ConsumerId FROM dbo.JobRuns WHERE JobId=@JobId AND RunNo=@RunNo; DECLARE @resource nvarchar(255)=CONCAT(\u0027DocAi.PageQuota.\u0027,@consumerId); IF @@TRANCOUNT=0 OR APPLOCK_MODE(\u0027public\u0027,@resource,\u0027Transaction\u0027)\u003C\u003E\u0027Exclusive\u0027 THROW 50016, \u0027Consumer quota lock must precede settlement.\u0027, 1; SELECT @status=Status,@pages=PageCount FROM dbo.JobRuns WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE JobId=@JobId AND RunNo=@RunNo; SELECT TOP(1) @usageId=UsageId,@operationId=OperationId FROM dbo.UsageLedger WHERE JobId=@JobId AND RunNo=@RunNo AND ReversesUsageId IS NULL ORDER BY UsageId; IF @usageId IS NOT NULL BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.PageReservations WHERE JobId=@JobId AND RunNo=@RunNo) RETURN; IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.CustomerPageCharges WHERE JobId=@JobId AND RunNo=@RunNo) INSERT dbo.CustomerPageCharges(JobId,RunNo,ConsumerId,Pages,UsageId,OperationId) VALUES(@JobId,@RunNo,@consumerId,@pages,@usageId,@operationId); UPDATE dbo.PageReservations SET State=\u0027Charged\u0027,SettledAtUtc=SYSUTCDATETIME(),OperationId=@operationId WHERE JobId=@JobId AND RunNo=@RunNo AND State\u003C\u003E\u0027Charged\u0027; END ELSE IF @status\u003C\u003E\u0027Active\u0027 BEGIN UPDATE dbo.PageReservations SET State=\u0027Released\u0027,SettledAtUtc=SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE JobId=@JobId AND RunNo=@RunNo AND State=\u0027Reserved\u0027; -- Fixed operational signal, no document/customer values. C# maps this to an error log event. IF @status=\u0027Completed\u0027 AND @@ROWCOUNT\u003E0 RAISERROR(\u0027page_quota.completed_without_billed_usage\u0027,10,1); END; END;","uses_ansi_nulls":true,"uses_quoted_identifier":true,"is_disabled":null,"is_instead_of_trigger":null,"is_not_for_replication":null}

{"schema":"dbo","name":"TR_Allowance_Insert","type":"TR","definition":"CREATE TRIGGER dbo.TR_Allowance_Insert ON dbo.PageAllowanceGrants INSTEAD OF INSERT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; -- One audit request at a time; the lock precedes every accounting read/write. IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inserted)\u003C\u003E1 THROW 50017, \u0027One allowance request is required.\u0027, 1; DECLARE @consumerId smallint=(SELECT ConsumerId FROM inserted); EXEC dbo.AcquirePageQuotaLock @consumerId; IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i JOIN dbo.PageAllowanceGrants g ON g.RequestId=i.RequestId) BEGIN IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i JOIN dbo.PageAllowanceGrants g ON g.RequestId=i.RequestId WHERE g.ConsumerId\u003C\u003Ei.ConsumerId OR g.Pages\u003C\u003Ei.Pages OR g.Kind\u003C\u003Ei.Kind OR ISNULL(g.OriginalGrantId,0)\u003C\u003EISNULL(i.OriginalGrantId,0) OR g.OperatorIdentity\u003C\u003Ei.OperatorIdentity OR g.Note\u003C\u003Ei.Note) THROW 50017, \u0027Allowance request identity conflict.\u0027, 1; RETURN; END; IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i JOIN dbo.PageAllowanceGrants g ON g.GrantId=i.OriginalGrantId WHERE i.Kind=\u0027Reversal\u0027 AND (i.Pages\u003C\u003E-g.Pages OR i.ConsumerId\u003C\u003Eg.ConsumerId OR g.Kind\u003C\u003E\u0027TopUp\u0027)) THROW 50017, \u0027Invalid allowance reversal.\u0027, 1; IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i JOIN dbo.PageAllowanceGrants r ON r.OriginalGrantId=i.OriginalGrantId WHERE i.Kind=\u0027Reversal\u0027 AND r.Kind=\u0027Reversal\u0027) THROW 50017, \u0027TopUp already reversed.\u0027, 1; INSERT dbo.PageAllowanceGrants(ConsumerId,Pages,Kind,OriginalGrantId,OperatorIdentity,Note,RequestId,BalanceAfter) SELECT i.ConsumerId,i.Pages,i.Kind,i.OriginalGrantId,i.OperatorIdentity,i.Note,i.RequestId,b.AvailablePages\u002Bi.Pages FROM inserted i JOIN dbo.ConsumerPageBalance b ON b.ConsumerId=i.ConsumerId; END;","uses_ansi_nulls":true,"uses_quoted_identifier":true,"is_disabled":false,"is_instead_of_trigger":true,"is_not_for_replication":false}

{"schema":"dbo","name":"TR_PageCharge_Integrity","type":"TR","definition":"CREATE TRIGGER dbo.TR_PageCharge_Integrity ON dbo.CustomerPageCharges AFTER INSERT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i JOIN dbo.PageReservations r ON r.JobId=i.JobId AND r.RunNo=i.RunNo JOIN dbo.UsageLedger l ON l.UsageId=i.UsageId JOIN dbo.AzureOperations o ON o.OperationId=i.OperationId WHERE i.Pages\u003C\u003Er.Pages OR i.ConsumerId\u003C\u003Er.ConsumerId OR l.ConsumerId\u003C\u003Ei.ConsumerId OR l.JobId\u003C\u003Ei.JobId OR l.RunNo\u003C\u003Ei.RunNo OR l.OperationId\u003C\u003Ei.OperationId OR l.ReversesUsageId IS NOT NULL OR o.JobId\u003C\u003Ei.JobId OR o.RunNo\u003C\u003Ei.RunNo OR o.State\u003C\u003E\u0027Succeeded\u0027) THROW 50017, \u0027Customer charge must match billed run usage.\u0027, 1; END;","uses_ansi_nulls":true,"uses_quoted_identifier":true,"is_disabled":false,"is_instead_of_trigger":false,"is_not_for_replication":false}

{"schema":"dbo","name":"TR_Reservation_Integrity","type":"TR","definition":"CREATE TRIGGER dbo.TR_Reservation_Integrity ON dbo.PageReservations AFTER INSERT,UPDATE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i JOIN dbo.JobRuns r ON r.JobId=i.JobId AND r.RunNo=i.RunNo WHERE i.ConsumerId\u003C\u003Er.ConsumerId OR i.Pages\u003C\u003Er.PageCount) THROW 50017, \u0027Reservation must match its run.\u0027, 1; IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i JOIN deleted d ON i.JobId=d.JobId AND i.RunNo=d.RunNo WHERE i.ConsumerId\u003C\u003Ed.ConsumerId OR i.Pages\u003C\u003Ed.Pages OR i.ReservedAtUtc\u003C\u003Ed.ReservedAtUtc OR (d.State\u003C\u003E\u0027Reserved\u0027 AND (i.State\u003C\u003Ed.State OR ISNULL(i.OperationId,0)\u003C\u003EISNULL(d.OperationId,0) OR i.SettledAtUtc\u003C\u003Ed.SettledAtUtc))) THROW 50017, \u0027Settled reservations are immutable.\u0027, 1; END;","uses_ansi_nulls":true,"uses_quoted_identifier":true,"is_disabled":false,"is_instead_of_trigger":false,"is_not_for_replication":false}
